practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: The test shows signs of heavy automated generation: generic name 'test11' and EvoSuite-specific imports and runner usage. These are indications of autogenerated verbose tests.

practices_evaluation.justification: The test appears minimal and written after-the-fact (single exceptional scenario). There is no Given-When-Then structure or BDD-style naming to indicate test-first design or prioritization.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: The test interacts only with public APIs (FPHeapMin.copia and retiraMin) and does not use reflection or inspect private state, so it verifies behavior through the public interface.

practices_evaluation.justification: The test uses only local variables and does not create persistent resources or modify global/static state. There is no evidence of resource leakage or missing cleanup in the visible method.
